full_details: Shrew played at two, and you were not in it. You came home after it. The sheet was not on that road. You went out again. At the gate a proclamation was nailed, the royal arms at the head, the ink still smelling. Given at Greenwich this fourth of July. No unlawful assemblies in or about the City, on pain of martial law, and Sir Thomas Wilford named provost marshal. Gillis read it slower than you, twice. It says nothing of strangers. Two men argued a wedding from the heading, and neither had read past it. You did not tell them what a playhouse yard is. You copied the heading onto your tables. A mounted man looked, and you went in under the arch one at a time. At home, to no one, you said a playhouse yard is two thousand people gathered by a flag. Tomorrow you come back from Shoreditch by Bishopsgate Street, not by the fields.
one_sentence: You came home from Shrew, then at Bishopsgate heard Gillis read a proclamation twice, and alone you said a yard is two thousand gathered by a flag.
title: Copied the heading at Bishopsgate
